title: Record auth failures per credential and notify the owner once
goal: A rejected credential is recorded with its time and the owner gets one notice naming it and the rotate command
acceptance: One failing-first test per kind: Telegram 401, cloud 401, APNs rejected JWT, Gmail invalid_grant
One notice per failure streak; a later success clears it
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: four call sites into one recorder. Not a measurement.
